breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses P_cr = π²EI/(KL)² with K=0.5 directly entering the effective length calculation (KL = 1000 mm), matching the ground truth. It does not include the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt that treated K as affecting only the mode shape while evaluating the Euler load from π²EI/L². The computation properly applies K in the denominator, yielding P_cr ≈ 1,579,137 N (≈ 1,579 kN), which is consistent with using the effective length KL = 1000 mm.
